top_signals.title: S&P 500 Hovers Near All-Time High Before Earnings: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Stocks fluctuated near their all-time highs as traders looked ahead to the start of the earnings season and inflation data that will be key in shaping the Federal Reserve outlook.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: LVMH Sales at Key Unit Fall as China Woes Hurt Louis Vuitton
top_signals.summary: LVMH’s biggest division posted a slump in sales last quarter as its key Louis Vuitton brand suffered from a boycott in China.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Energy Stocks Soared in Q3 as Fuel Markets Tightened
top_signals.summary: The energy sector came roaring back in the third quarter of 2026. After finishing at the bottom of the sector rankings in Q2, Energy gained 16.5% in Q3, easily outpacing every other sector and the S&P 500’s 2.0% return. That was a remarkable turnaround, but the headline sector number doesn’t fully capture what happened beneath the surface, because returns varied dramatically across different parts of the energy business. The biggest winners weren’t the companies producing oil and gas. They were the companies turning crude…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: ‘We’ve drowned ourselves in buzzwords’: Acting US Army secretary gives sermon-like first speech
top_signals.summary: Adam Telle enlisted the Old Testament to preach a message of simplicity of purpose on Monday in his first public speech to troops since assuming the role.
